data.name: Gerald
data.gender_notes: Gerald is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gerald is recorded in name-lists as “Spear ruler”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gerald expresses “Spear ruler”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerald total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_greek.name: Ελληνικά_Gerald

in_latin.name: Gerald
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gerald est nomen Christianum quod significat Spear ruler. Hoc nomen in cultura Christiana est valde significativum.
